sources.title: POCKET-35B: A 35B Model That Runs on Your Phone — Without a GPU
sources.snippet: POCKET-35B from VIDRAFT and FINAL-Bench is a 34.66B MoE model with ~3B active parameters per token. Quantized GGUF builds run on phones and laptops without a GPU via llama.cpp, Ollama, and MLX.
